head: codex/661-runtime-shepherd-provider-reply
title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Route Shepherd conversation replies through provider
body:
Closes #661

Summary:
- Routes resident Shepherd conversation recipients through the configured Shepherd/provider adapter instead of returning a synthetic acknowledgement.
- Carries the addressed conversation recipient id through the Shepherd request and projects only schema-, correlation-, runtime-, recipient-, and size-validated Shepherd responses into the public conversation reply contract.
- Preserves non-conversation Shepherd ingress behavior and surfaces provider failures without fallback replies.
